death.stabbed@closet: Hid in the closet. He looked in the closet.
death.stabbed@behind_furniture: Hid behind the couch. He walked around the couch.
death.stabbed@bed: Hid under the bed. He knelt down.
death.stabbed@bathroom: Hid in the tub. He had time.
death.stabbed@exposed: Ran at him with a knife. He also had a knife.
death.stabbed@prone: Slipped on the oil. Then he arrived.
death.stabbed@stunned: Still seeing stars when he reached me.
death.stabbed: He found me. It took him {time} seconds.
death.shock: Turned on the tap, stood in the kitchen, threw the toaster. Physics.
death.burning: Lit the curtains. Stayed to watch.
death.explosion: Gas, then a flame. Briefly very loud.
ending.evade: Called for help. Help was seventy-five seconds away.
ending.disable: He is under the bookshelf. He is still there.
ending.kill: He came in through the water.
death.stabbed@zone_kitchen: Stood in the kitchen. The door opens into the kitchen.
death.stabbed@zone_living: Stood in the middle of the room. Seventy seconds of planning.
death.stabbed@zone_bed: Was at the nightstand. The call did not finish.
death.stabbed@zone_bath: Was in the bathroom, not in the tub. A distinction he did not make.
attacker.breached: The {what} slowed him down. It did not stop him.
